quests.instruction: What item do we wear that has no sleeves at all, just two thin straps, and also under a jacket, so we still feel cool once it's off?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: It has no sleeves, only two thin straps!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: A tank top has no sleeves at all, just two thin straps!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our ears, connected by a padded band across our head, and also on a freezing, windy day to keep our ears from hurting?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: They cover just your ears, not your whole head!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Earmuffs only cover your ears, connected by a band over your head!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that sits at our collar, tied into a neat little bow shape, and also for a very fancy party, tied just below our chin?
quests.question: Bow Tie
quests.hint: It is shaped like a little bow, not a long strip!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: A bow tie is tied into a neat little bow instead of hanging long!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that ties around our neck and flows out behind us, and also instead of a jacket, for a bold, heroic look?
quests.question: Cape
quests.hint: It ties at your neck and flows out behind you!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: A cape ties at the neck and flows out dramatically behind you!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our shoulders instead of a belt, to hold pants up, and also instead of a belt, when we want our hands free of adjusting?
quests.question: Suspenders
quests.hint: They go over your shoulders, not around your waist!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: Suspenders hold pants up using your shoulders instead of your waist!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that covers our whole body, from our neck to our ankles, in one piece, and also instead of just a coat, for a whole day of playing in deep snow?
quests.question: Snowsuit
quests.hint: It covers your WHOLE body, all in one piece!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: A snowsuit covers your whole body in one thick, puffy piece!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that is thick, soft, and warm, but has no hood at all, and also after playing sports, to stay warm while we cool down?
quests.question: Sweatshirt
quests.hint: It is thick and warm, but has NO hood!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: A sweatshirt is thick and warm, but unlike a hoodie, it has no hood!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our head to stay safe while riding a bike, and also before we skateboard, ski, or ride a scooter?
quests.question: Helmet
quests.hint: It keeps your head safe during sports!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: A helmet has a hard outside that protects your head from bumps!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear before we get on a boat or go swimming in deep water, and also on a canoe or sailboat, to stay safe near deep water?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: It helps you float on water!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: A life jacket is filled with material that helps you float on water!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear under a sweater or jacket to stay extra warm?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You tuck this into your pants sometimes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: A clean shirt every day helps you feel fresh and comfy.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear instead of pants, with a shirt on top?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It swishes when you walk or twirl.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Some skirts are pleated, which means they have neat folds all around.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear with two long legs that go all the way to our ankles?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear a belt to help hold these up.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants keep your legs warm and protected when you play outside.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our shirt when the house feels chilly, and also on a cool autumn day before winter arrives?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: It is soft, warm, and often knitted!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Some families like to wear matching sweaters for winter photos.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that we wrap around and around before going outside?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It keeps icy wind off your neck.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Some people wear light scarves in summer just for looking stylish.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear before we go outside to build a snowman, and also to keep each finger warm and toasty?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: They go on your hands!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some gloves have special grippy palms for holding onto things.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that comes in matching pairs of two, and also to keep our toes warm and cozy?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: They go on your feet before your shoes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Wearing matching socks is fun, but wearing silly mismatched ones is fun too.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our feet at the beach in summer?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Think about this: They have straps instead of covering your whole foot.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Some sandals are made specially for walking in shallow water.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when snow is falling outside our window, and also to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: It is thicker and warmer than a jacket!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: The longer a coat is, the more of your legs it can keep warm.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our hands when it is extra freezing outside?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Think about this: Only your thumb gets its own little space.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Only your thumb gets its own separate space in a mitten.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of long pants when the weather is warm, and also when we run and play outside in the heat?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: They cover your legs, but only a little bit!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: You can play sports easily in a comfy pair of shorts.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our head with a curved brim in the front?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Think about this: Baseball players often wear these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Many sports teams have their own special caps with a logo.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of sandals with lots of straps, for easy beach days?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: Hint: You can slide these on in one second flat.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops are one of the fastest shoes to slide on and off.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with a fun picture or pattern printed on the front, and also on a warm day when we do not need long sleeves?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: It has short sleeves!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: T-shirts are named for their shape, which looks like the letter T!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear with a soft hood we can pull up over our head?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: Think about this: It usually has a big front pocket.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Many hoodies have a warm front pocket, perfect for cold hands.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on a very hot day, to keep our arms totally cool?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: It keeps your arms totally cool.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: Tank tops keep your arms cool on the very hottest days.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of a hat, when only our ears feel cold?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: They look a little like headphones.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Earmuffs were invented by a boy who was tired of his cold ears.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of a long tie, for a fun, fancy look?
quests.question: Bow Tie
quests.hint: It sits right at your collar.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: Some bow ties even clip on, so there's no tying needed at all.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that farmers and painters often wear to protect their clothes?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: Hint: Farmers often wear these while working.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Overalls have a big front pocket, perfect for carrying small tools.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that is thinner and smoother than leggings?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: Hint: Dancers often wear these to ballet class.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights are thinner and smoother than stretchy leggings.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that is thick, fluffy, and perfect for lazy mornings?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: Hint: It is thick, fluffy, and cozy.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: Hotels often leave a cozy bathrobe for guests to relax in.
